AI Song Maker 1.0.0 — initial release

- Generate original songs from text prompts or uploaded melodies and audio tracks.
- Supports uploads up to 200MB (MP3, WAV, MP4, AAC) with fast cloud-based rendering.
- Simple setup with automatic token management and session creation.
- Exports high-quality 1080p MP4 within 1–2 minutes; multiple file formats supported.
- Built-in workflows for editing, previewing, and exporting songs for content creators.
